tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /snying po don bsdus zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

/ snying po don bsdus zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhi dbyings 'od gsal dri med rnam dag la/ /rtogs pa mngon gyur rgyal ba dgongs brgyud dang*/ /rig 'dzin brda brgyud gang zag snyan khung brgyud/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas lhun grub 'od gsal snying po'i don/ /ji ltar bdag gis rtogs bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /thog ma'i 'od gsal ka dag lhun grub nyid/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i snying po can/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa'i rang bzhin te/ /gang du ma grub 'char gzhi'i dbyings su gnas/ /shel la 'od bzhin lhun grub mdangs shar bas/ /gzhir snang spyi gzhi ma nges lhun grub las/ /thugs rjai'i rtsal gyis rang snang rang ngo shes/ /yul phyir ma 'brangs 'gyu ba rang thog chod/ /gzhi las ma g.yos shel 'od bsdus pa bzhin/ /kun tu bzang po gzhi thog grol ba yin/ /de nyid ma rig gsum gyi rang bzhin las/ /'od las yul dang lus kyi 'khrul gzhir gyur/ /thugs rje'i rig rtsal rtog pa'i sems su 'khrul/ khams gsum rigs drug so so'i snang ba shar/ /'khrul dus 'gro la bde gshegs snying pos khyab/ /lus ngag yid gsum bag chags sbubs kyis bsgribs/ /'od kyang snying dbus gzhon nu bum pa'i sku/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum du gnas/ /ngo bo skur gnas chos sku stong pa'i dang*/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal lhun grub mdangs dang bcas/ / thugs rje'i rig pa sprul skur 'char byed tshul/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i don/ /gang gis nyams su len pa sus 'dod pa/ /lta stangs gzigs stangs gnad du bcun pa yis/ /dbyings rig rang snang 'od gsal don la gnas/ /mngon sum gong 'phel tshad phebs zad pa yis/ /rlung sems stongs te shel 'od bsdus pa bzhin/ /ka dag ngang du gzigs snang mya ngan 'das/ /gzhi nyid 'bras bur smin pas ye shes gsum/

/chos sku longs sku sprul skur rnam par dag /chos skur gcig pas longs sprul 'char gzhi'i cha/ /lhun grub thugs rje gting gsal phra mo'i tshul/ /shel gong rang so dri ma med pa bzhin/ /de las gzhi snang 'bras snang gnas 'gyur las/ /longs sprul phyir snang gdul bya'i zhing khams su/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa mtha' yas lhun gyis grub/ /'di ni mthar thug don gyi dgongs pa yin/ /dge bas 'gro kun mngon par byang chub shog /snying po don bsdus zhes bya ba/ /rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ zab mo yang tig snying po don bsdus/ -PAGE 196-- PAGE 197 - -PAGE 196-
